messages:
Nina Gomez: Opening a relnotes draft for the runtime changes (batching profiles + KV cache tuning). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5110
Ravi Patel: Nice. Can you drop the short bullets you want in the announcement so I can copyedit and add SDK examples?
Nina Gomez: TL;DR bullets: 1) New batching profiles: low-latency, balanced-throughput, cost-optimized-1. 2) KV cache tuning reduces memory and improves prefix reuse. 3) Router default now prefers same-region replicas to improve p99. 4) Known caveat: metric underreporting in canaries while prefix cache warms up.
Oliver Zhang: For the SDK snippets, prefer Python + Node examples. Drafts look like:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.routes.update('checkout', batching_profile='low-latency')
```
```
// node
await client.routes.update('checkout', { batchingProfile: 'low-latency' })
```
Ravi Patel: Also include a short migration note for customers: test profiles in staging, then enable via route config; Dedicated customers can pin at pool level with `poolConfig: { batchingProfile: 'balanced-throughput' }` and should recycle long-lived workers.
docs-bot: Reminder: add whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter. Example frontmatter:
```
---
date: 2025-06-10
title: "Batching profiles and KV cache tuning"
components: [runtime, routing]
---
```
Nina Gomez: Added frontmatter and a tiny whats-new blurb in the PR. Ravi, can you paste the SDK blocks into the PR and add a tiny callout about the canary caveat linking to https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2427?
Ravi Patel: Done and pushed. Also added a 3-step QA checklist: smoke test staging, run p95/p99 ramp, watch canary dashboard for 15 mins.
Oliver Zhang: LGTM. No blockers from engineering.
Nina Gomez: Planning to merge after CI and schedule publish tomorrow 07:30 PDT. Will ping eng-oncall at merge for early monitoring. :rocket:
